import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long[] vst = new long[1000006];

    static long f(long x, long y) {
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 30; i >= 0; i--) {
            res = (res * res) % MOD;
            if (((1L << i) & y) != 0) {
                res = (res * x) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        long ans = 0;

        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(f(p, p));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        for (long i = 1; i < p; i++) {
            if (vst[(int) i] == 0) {
                vst[(int) i] = 1;
                ans++;
                long cur = (i * k) % p;
                while (vst[(int) cur] == 0) {
                    vst[(int) cur] = 1;
                    cur = (cur * k) % p;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(f(p, ans));
        sc.close();
    }
}
